title: Understanding the role of a specific microenvironment in personal exposure to semi-volatile organic compounds using silicone wristbands
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, 27,2464-2478
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00206K, Paper
Zülfikar Akmermer, Hale Demirtepe
Silicone wristbands deployed as air–wrist pairs demonstrated that office air affects personal exposure to fluorene, tri(n-butyl) phosphate, and tris(2-chloro isopropyl) phosphate.
